scope: Verb t-d alternation and negative future participles
finding: Negative future participle transition missing: -(y)AcAk/part rule 132 exists only from verbRoot, not afterNegation. Positive future participles accept; negative and inability participles fail at possessive n.
evidence: yapacağınız/geleceğiniz accept in production and default isolated roots.
All three offsets change reddedemeyeceğiniz/reddedemeyeceğimiz to reddedemeyeceğimmiş, and reddedemeyeceğin to reddedemeyeceğim.
Production t-d alternation controls work; four deliberately unsoftened negative controls rejected.
rejected_hypothesis: A generic failure of final t-d softening is not supported by these probes.
limits: Core harness, fresh profile; no simulator validation.
Missing morphology does not always cause substitution: several rejected forms remained unchanged.
Isolated default roots only contain gel/yap/oku/söyle; do not interpret isolated rejection of unrelated roots.
Initial generated tat negative forms had incorrect harmony; corrected and reran entire initial corpus before final analysis.
validation: Final 48-case audit, 24-case followup and 20-surface path audit all completed with zero test failures.
